en: From the Master Grade series, "Mobile Suit Gundam UC" MS is released one after another!
MG Zaku Cannon is commercialized in the color that appears in the "Mobile Suit Gundam UC" movie.
- Thoroughly reproduce the appearance image in the play with molded colors! !
・Based on Ver.2.0, which features flexible movement,
Equipped with detailed gimmicks such as movable mono-eye, cockpit hatch/interior slide, and attachment/detachment of the big gun.
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product materials: PS, PE, ABS
